findings.evidence: PosSemidef.lean:102-107 and :126-136 are the same four-line pattern; the bridge mirrors TauCeti's own `simpa only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.submatrix, Matrix.of_apply, Pi.star_apply, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc] using (hK.submatrix v).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x` at upstream/TauCeti/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/PosSemidef.lean:110-111.
findings.fix: Extract one reusable lemma, e.g. `lemma posSemidef_of_isHermitian_of_submatrix {N : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : N.IsHermitian) (h : ∀ {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (v : ι → n) (x : ι → 𝕜), 0 ≤ star x ⬝ᵥ (N.submatrix v v *ᵥ x)) : N.PosSemidef`, prove the dotProduct↔double-sum bridge once there with a `simp only` list, and have both `map_re` and `posSemidef_map_ofReal_iff` call it.
findings.issue: `PosSemidef.map_re` (lines 100-107) and `posSemidef_map_ofReal_iff` (lines 123-136) repeat identical scaffolding: `refine TauCeti.posSemidef_iff_finite_sum.mpr ⟨fun a b => ?_, fun {ι : Type} _ v x => ?_⟩`, the hermitian leg `(h.1.map _ fun z => by simp).apply b a`, and the same six-lemma non-`only` `simpa [dotProduct, mulVec, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]` (lines 106-107 and 135-136). That `simpa` is the non-obvious step — converting `0 ≤ star x ⬝ᵥ (N.submatrix v v *ᵥ x)` into the `∑ i, ∑ j, star (x i) * K (v i) (v j) * x j` shape of `TauCeti.posSemidef_iff_finite_sum` — and is written twice with an unfolding-heavy simp set rather than factored out.

findings.evidence: upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/Basic.lean:326 `re := ⟨⟨Complex.re, _⟩, _⟩`; the identification is a named Mathlib lemma, `RCLike.re_to_complex` (Analysis/Complex/Basic.lean:482).
findings.fix: Make the identification explicit: add a ℂ-specific bridge in PosSemidef.lean (`lemma PosSemidef.map_complexRe {M : Matrix n n ℂ} (hM : M.PosSemidef) : (M.map Complex.re).PosSemidef`, proved via `RCLike.re_to_complex`) and use it here, or at minimum attach a comment naming `RCLike.re_to_complex` at the use site.
findings.issue: `SpinDensityC.re` sets `mat := ρ.mat.map Complex.re` and discharges `posSemidef := ρ.posSemidef.map_re`, but `Matrix.PosSemidef.map_re` concludes `(M.map ⇑(RCLike.re : 𝕜 →+ ℝ)).PosSemidef` (PosSemidef.lean:65 `open RCLike`, :100-101). The field typechecks only by unfolding the `RCLike ℂ` instance and the `AddMonoidHom` coercion to `Complex.re`; nothing in the file documents that identification.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Analysis/RCLike/Basic.lean:98 `@[coe] abbrev ofReal : ℝ → K := Algebra.cast`; Mathlib/Basic/Complex/Basic.lean:85 `instance : Coe ℝ ℂ := ⟨ofReal⟩` — two distinct constants.
findings.fix: Bridge with `Complex.coe_algebraMap` (used this way at Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Positive.lean:82) or add a ℂ-specific corollary of `posSemidef_map_ofReal_iff` in PosSemidef.lean; failing that, comment the defeq at this site.
findings.issue: Same pattern for the coercion: `SpinDensity.toSpinDensityC` uses `mat := ρ.mat.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)`, which resolves to `Complex.ofReal` (Mathlib/Basic/Complex/Basic.lean:82-86), while `Matrix.posSemidef_map_ofReal_iff` is stated with the `RCLike` coercion `RCLike.ofReal = Algebra.cast` (Mathlib/Analysis/RCLike/Basic.lean:98-103). `(... (𝕜 := ℂ)).mpr ρ.posSemidef` is accepted only up to defeq through the `Algebra ℝ ℂ` instance, undocumented.

findings.evidence: ComplexSpinDensity.lean:166 `lemma f1_re : PDF.f1 ρ.re = ρ.f1 := rfl` and :170 `lemma g1_re : PDF.g1 ρ.re = ρ.deltaQ := rfl`.
findings.fix: Replace with `PDF.f1_nonneg ρ.re` / `PDF.abs_g1_le_f1 ρ.re` directly, or `by simpa using PDF.abs_g1_le_f1 ρ.re` if a syntactic nudge is wanted.
findings.issue: `f1_nonneg := ρ.f1_re ▸ PDF.f1_nonneg ρ.re` and `abs_deltaQ_le_f1 := ρ.f1_re ▸ ρ.g1_re ▸ PDF.abs_g1_le_f1 ρ.re` (line 195) rewrite with `▸` — a chained `▸` whose motive inference is fragile — even though `f1_re` and `g1_re` are `rfl`, so the rewrites change nothing the elaborator needs.

summary: Two proofs in PosSemidef.lean duplicate the same non-obvious bridging step to TauCeti's finite-sum characterisation, each closed by an unfolding-heavy non-`only` `simpa`; and both `SpinDensityC.re` and `SpinDensity.toSpinDensityC` typecheck only through undocumented definitional equalities between distinct Mathlib constants (`⇑(RCLike.re : ℂ →+ ℝ)` vs `Complex.re`, `Algebra.cast` vs `Complex.ofReal`).
